answer.summary: Hackathon OS coordinates 24-48 hour teams through a linear execution operating system. It combines real-time SSE live sync with an automated backend AI gateway.
reasons: Enforces mandatory rubric confirmation gates before coding begins, preventing disqualified submissions.
Replaces unstructured chat chaos with synchronized workspaces: Silent Ideation, 4-Step Plan Vault, and Kanban Board.
Synchronizes all teammates in real time via virtual-threaded Server-Sent Events with optimistic locking.
answer.scope: Covers React 19 + Vite frontend, Spring Boot 4.1 backend, PostgreSQL 17, and Groq-hosted LLaMA 3.3 70B & Whisper STT AI gateway.

panels.title: How does a team progress from brief intake to final pitch?

items.detail: Multimodal OCR ingests competition PDFs. The team leader confirms every extracted rule before ideation unlocks. [](source:brief-src)
Members draft ideas without bias until revealed. AI stress tests feasibility before the room locks a winner. [](source:ideate-src)
AiService generates PRD, Architecture, Phases, and Demo Script into a versioned 9-doc Markdown vault. [](source:plan-src)
Phase-driven Kanban board coordinates tasks with dependency checks. Reality Ledger tracks what was actually built. [](source:board-src)
Live mic telemetry evaluates pace, Judge's Chair trains defense, and link checkers verify repos before sign-off. [](source:pitch-src)

panels.title: What architectural safeguards guarantee production stability?

items: Reverse Proxy IP Resolution: ClientIpResolver parses x-vercel-forwarded-for literals, preventing shared 429 rate limit buckets.
Circuit Breaking & Bulkheads: ExternalCallBulkhead isolates Groq LLM calls (max 6 concurrent) with 45-second timeouts.
Distributed PostgreSQL Locks: Advisory locks 1010L and 1011L ensure scheduled jobs never execute concurrently across instances.
Spring Session Persistence: JDBC-backed HTTP sessions prevent user logout storms during container redeployments and cold starts.
